name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 11 – subpoint a Decision (EU) 2021/1764 – Article 85 – § 2 – 88
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: 2. The OCTs shall also be eligible for support under Union’s external financing instruments subject to the rules, objectives and arrangements of those programmes. The OCTs shall be eligible for support under Regulation (EC) No 1257/96.11 Non-governmental organisations established in OCTs shall be eligible for financing in accordance with Article 7 of Regulation (EC) No 1257/96. Funding for non-governmental organisations shall be granted exclusively for clearly defined humanitarian measures, the needs, objectives, intended beneficiaries and expected results of which have been documented in a verifiable manner in advance. Union funds may not be used, either directly or indirectly, for lobbying activities, party-political or election-related activities, political campaigns or any other activities that do not directly serve the purpose of life-saving humanitarian aid. Funding for any activities that encourage or facilitate illegal migration, or benefit migrants who have already entered illegally, shall also be excluded. Recipients shall fully disclose the use of all funds and any onward transfer of funds to third parties. The Commission shall ensure regular audits of the use of funds and shall publish information on recipients, amounts awarded, funding purposes and results achieved. In the event of infringements of these provisions, the funds shall be recovered and the recipients concerned shall be excluded from further funding.
